title: Federal learning method, system and terminal for injecting model watermark at server side
assignee: Harbin Institute Of Technology shenzhen Shenzhen Institute Of Science And Technology Innovation Harbin Institute Of Technology

pse.problem: Federated learning can lead to intellectual property infringement due to independent watermark injection during local training, causing mutual interference that reduces the recognition rate of watermarks and main task accuracy.
pse.solution_function: The invention enables server-side model watermark injection in federated learning by generating watermark parameters and distributing them to participating devices. These devices then train the target model with the received watermark parameters, improving intellectual property protection and reducing interference during aggregation.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include a central server, participating devices, and a watermark generator. The server coordinates federated learning, generates watermark parameters, and distributes them to participating devices.
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Obtain the target model and watermark strings from multiple participants. 2. Send the target model to participating devices for local training, generating a global model after each federated round. 3. Generate watermark parameters before each training and distribute them to participating devices. 4. During each training, update the global model with the current one and train it using the distributed watermark parameters.
pse.effect: Improved intellectual property protection through coordinated server-side watermark injection, minimizing mutual interference during aggregation and preserving main task accuracy.
